title: zeroship.jsonc
description: The canonical creator project configuration. Read by the zeroship CLI and by the build toolchain; NEVER by the runtime, and never packed into a .zship. See docs/reference/project-config.md.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Ignored by both readers.

name.description: The project name. Used as the app name when `zeroship deploy` auto-creates.

app.description: The deploy target's app id (uuid) or name. Absent on a fresh project: the first `zeroship deploy` auto-creates and reports the id to paste here.

control.description: Control-plane base URL. There is NO Rust-side fallback: an absent key is an error naming the key, never a silent http://localhost:9090.

runtime_date.description: RESERVED. The runtime does not branch on it and no compatibility mechanism exists. The format is validated so the habit of writing it is established before the first gated behaviour change.

build.description: The build shape. `output` crosses the tool boundary (the packer writes it, `zeroship deploy` reads it); the rest is plugin-only.

migrations.description: Where migrations are authored and where the fold is written. Both cross the tool boundary; both are x-cli-read.

secrets.description: Secret NAMES only. Values live in .env (dev) and `zeroship secret set` (deployed); deploy warns when a declared deployed value is absent. An array of strings has nowhere to put a value.

environments.description: Named deploy targets, selected with --env=<name>. There is no implicit environment and no ZEROSHIP_ENV fallback.

additionalProperties.description: `app` and `control` are NON-INHERITABLE: an environment that names a control and inherits the root app is exactly the silent cross-targeting this rule exists to prevent. Everything else inherits, per member.

protected.description: `zeroship migrate` against a protected environment requires --yes.

mode.description: "full" emits manifest.worker; "static" is an SSG-only deploy with no worker.

serverEntry.description: Server entry relative to the project root. Omit for auto-detection.

dist.description: The directory the client build writes, and the only directory the packer walks. The schema rejects the direct root and parent spellings; both readers additionally resolve the path and reject any directory containing zeroship.jsonc.

output.description: The .zship path the packer writes and `zeroship deploy` uploads.

dir.description: Migration sources, relative to the project root.

out.description: The gen-types output dir holding env.db.ts, schema.runtime.json and migrations.ir.json. `zeroship migrate` posts <out>/migrations.ir.json.
